exposure: Maternal weight at different time points
Maternal weight gain (increase in weight at 32 weeks of gestation compared to predelivery stage)
Maternal weight increase of more than 2 kg in a 4-week gestation period
cohort: A total of 156 pregnant women were recruited, and their maternal weight was collected at different gestational weeks, along with maternal age, body mass index, delivery mode, delivery week, and infant weight.
finding: An increase in maternal weight gain after 32 weeks of gestation was associated with a reduced risk of low birth weight and premature babies.
